acquisition_match_method: Rank Groundsource event-discovery records using the closest OPERA metadata date to the reported start date, then count acquisition dates in fixed 30-day pre-event and post-event windows. Date-only matching is not a timestamp match and does not establish an independent event reference or QA-valid observation.

acquisition_opportunity_screen.calendar_precision_limit: OPERA register contains calendar dates only; exact granule timestamps were not matched here
acquisition_opportunity_screen.candidate_count_basis: distinct intersecting Groundsource event IDs per fixed AOI
acquisition_opportunity_screen.interpretation_limit: These are ranked archive-discovery leads only. News-derived event records are not official event verification, inundation labels, gauge observations, independent truth, or evidence of QA-valid samples. Candidate ranking uses acquisition metadata only and does not inspect product values.

interpretation_limit: Groundsource records are machine-extracted from news reports and geolocated for event discovery. Their geometries are not satellite-derived inundation boundaries, field observations, independent flood labels, or proof that flooding occurred throughout the polygon. News coverage and extraction may be geographically and temporally biased. Intersections do not establish comparable sampling, pixel quality, event attribution, or confirmatory enrollment.

source.title: Groundsource: A Dataset of Flood Events from News

spatial_test: WKB event geometry intersects each fixed WGS84 AOI bounding envelope
